info.name: Coinbase Advanced Trade Accounts Orders API
info.description:
The Coinbase Advanced Trade API provides programmatic access to advanced trading features on the Coinbase platform. Developers can automate market, limit, and stop-limit orders, manage portfolios, retrieve real-time and historical market data, and monitor fees. The REST API is available at api.coinbase.com/api/v3/brokerage and supports authenticated access using API keys with HMAC SHA-256 signatures. Public market data endpoints do not require authentication.

Contact Support:
 Name: Coinbase Developer Support
